Method of Attack: Collecting highly personal user data through shady tactics
Collecting full browsing history without anonymizing URLs
Collecting data on all pages visited instead of only pages where blocking occurred
Using Mobile Device Management (MDM) profile on iOS to gain full device control
Requesting Accessibility service access on Android to facilitate data collection
Lying in privacy policies claiming only non-personal and anonymized data collection
Masking company identity by using images for documents and privacy policies
Using different accounts in extension stores and hiding domain ownership
Attack Vector: Browser extensions and mobile apps installed on user devices
Installation of MDM profile on iOS devices
Requesting Accessibility service permissions on Android devices
Indicators of Compromise: Extensions and apps available in Chrome and Firefox extension stores
Android apps installed on around 11 million devices
iOS app prompting installation of MDM profile
Privacy policies only available as images
Use of multiple accounts in extension stores
